Subject: SOC2 evidence handoff & renewal window

Hi Priyom,

Hope youre well. As we prepare for our upcoming renewal, Acme needs to re-run the SOC2 evidence handoff for the period we discussed earlier. Our audit window is targeting mid-September, and procurement asked me to gather a list of artifacts and an intake plan so we can schedule uploads and any temporary retention adjustments.

Can you confirm:
- A recommended staging window (start/end) for evidence uploads?
- Maximum recommended ingestion throughput / any burst capacity we can request?
- Log retention expectations (we may need a short-term bump to 365 days for a subset of event logs)

Date: 2026-08-22 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & renewal window

Thanks Jared nd team  for the note — this is straightforward and we can support the flow you described. Proposed plan below.

Summary plan (short):
- Staging window: Sept 7 - Sept 21 (14 days) for bulk evidence upload and verification.
- Pre-flight uploads: Aug 31 - Sept 3 (small sample uploads for schema check).
- Burst capacity: we can open a temporary 2x ingest pool during the staging window to accept high parallel uploads; typical recommendation is to coordinate 48-hour high-volume windows inside the 14-day window.
- Retention: we can increase the selected audit-log retention to 365 days for the scoped datasets for the duration of the audit (we keep the change live for 90 days post-upload then revert unless you request otherwise).

Operational items for your team:
1) Provide list of artifact owners + email addresses for upload notifications.
2) Confirm preferred intake method: S3 presigned upload, or shared Drive upload (we prefer S3 for large volumes).
3) Confirm any PII redaction/anonymization constraints (AuditOps asked about this last time).

Attachments: evidence-staging-plan.docx (plan + manifest template).

Next steps: If this looks good Ill loop in Karthik to outline the technical upload paths and cost/ingest implications. Marissa will run the pre-flight checks with your team during Aug 31-Sept 3.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Lead, Renewals | Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: evidence-staging-plan.docx (DOCX, 28KB)

Subject: Re: SOC2 evidence handoff & renewal window - technical notes

Hi Jared / Priyom,

Quick technical follow-up on uploads and log retention. TL;DR: S3 presigned is our recommended path for large bulk delivery; we can also provide a temporary dedicated ingestion pool to avoid throttling.

Details:
- Upload: presigned PUTs to an S3 bucket we provision for the window. Files should be organized under /acme-soc2/2026-09/{artifact_type}/.
- Manifest: a CSV manifest (filename, uploader_email, artifact_type, timestamp, sha256) is required to speed verification. See attached log-retention-params.txt for format expectations.
- Burst capacity: we can enable a dedicated ingest queue (2x baseline) for 72-hour blocks. Cost implications will be billed against the renewal uplift (we will estimate once you confirm expected peak GB/day).
- Retention flags: we will tag objects with retention=365d for scoped artifacts. We can also export a signed log bundle to your bucket after verification if you need a local copy.

If you expect more than ~4TB of uploads during the 14-day window please flag now so we can provision additional temporary throughput.

-Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: log-retention-params.txt (TXT, 3KB)
